sections: Global authority lock order and retained observations

repo_truth: Parent preflight and feasibility proof are complete. Native Windows strict read is repaired and six focused baselines pass. Parent owns new Charter artifact/intake modules. This lane owns only new authenticator/authority engine modules, focused tests, and narrowly required dependency manifest updates.
allowed_scope: Add new engine modules for strict canonical CTAP2 request/response codecs, total status mapping, exact 37-byte authenticator-data admission, DER ES256 verification, NativeAuthenticatorPortV1, caller-intent-only ApproverAdminRequestV1/ApproverAdminResultV1, and the in-memory/fake-port core of ApproverRegistryServiceV1.
Use the packet's frozen security schemas and vectors directly and validate all externally supplied bytes before semantic admission.

Edit only new files under crates/engine/src/ named charter_authenticator.rs, approver_registry.rs, or narrowly factored child modules; new focused crates/engine/tests/hcm_2_2_*security*.rs files; crates/engine/Cargo.toml; workspace Cargo.toml; Cargo.lock; and parent-coordinated additions to crates/engine/src/lib.rs.
Use RED tests first. Run focused tests with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=D:\codex-build\handbook-hcm22 and TEMP/TMP=D:\codex-temp\handbook-hcm22.
Run GitNexus impact before editing any existing function/class/method and stop before HIGH or CRITICAL edits.
non_goals: Do not edit definition/profile files, Charter artifact/intake modules, compiler, flow, CLI, setup, doctor, skills, proof/control, planning, handoff, ledger, or dispatch files.
Do not implement filesystem journals, promotion, lifecycle, platform-native adapters, or HCM-2.3 in this lane.
Do not add a software/unattended authenticator, caller-supplied ceremony record, semantic port method, browser WebAuthn origin, attestation trust claim, or real-world identity claim.
Do not commit or create handoffs, ledger rows, dispatches, or user-visible task hops.
tasks: Read the full dispatch, exact packet security sections, all referenced schemas/vectors, official CTAP2/RFC 8949/RFC 8785 sources, and current dependency/API boundaries.

Write RED vector tests for exact make-credential/get-assertion request bytes, strict success response decoding, every malformed/status/selection negative, user-handle derivation, total received-status mapping, and closed approver-admin request/result projections.
Implement the smallest safe engine-owned codec/crypto/port/service core that makes the focused vector wall green while preserving the exact opaque two-method port boundary.
Return dependency rationale, changed files, exact RED/GREEN evidence, unsupported transaction integration work, and every GitNexus impact result.
contracts_and_gates: The port has exactly make_credential(bytes)->bytes and get_assertion(bytes)->bytes and receives no semantic identity or authority field.

Engine-built CBOR is deterministic, definite-length, preferred-encoding, duplicate-free, exact-key ordered, and byte-closed; received success responses reject unknown/duplicate/indefinite/non-shortest/out-of-order/trailing data.

GetAssertion admits only exact keys 1/2/3, one selected allow-list descriptor, 37-byte authenticator data, SHA-256(handbook.local), flags byte 0x05, and strict DER ES256 verified by the committed registry key.
All complete nonzero CTAP status bytes use the frozen total disjoint mapping; AUTHENTICATOR_UNAVAILABLE is reserved for an out-of-band port exception before a complete status byte.
Every refused admin result publishes no semantic refs/fingerprints/changed paths and at least one exact next action.
stop_conditions: Stop before any HIGH or CRITICAL existing-symbol edit and return the blast radius to the parent.
Return blocked if an exact frozen vector conflicts with the official protocol source or available safe-Rust dependency boundary.
Return blocked if a required security property needs work outside the allowed files or a weaker fallback.
